rca of the issue: Two clear root causes: (1) prefix resolver was authored against a different/older kind taxonomy than what FIELD_LEADERSHIP_KINDS actually defines today — a string-equality miss (singular vs plural) silently sends every supervisor_notes record to the catch-all 'FL' prefix. Reproduce: POST /api/field-leadership with kind='supervisor_notes' → response.record.doc_id starts with 'FL-' not 'FLN-'. (2) Backend find-by-doc-id returns hard-coded frontend route paths (server.py 7039-7060) but App.js was not extended to render those paths — admin search succeeds at the API layer then dead-ends at a blank page. Mitigation: either co-locate the route map next to the React router config, or have the API return collection+id and let the frontend pick the route from a single registry.
